topic: Digital miner maintenance: where the money goes
title: Digital Miner Maintenance: Where the Money Goes
hook: Own a digital miner? Here is where the maintenance goes.

scenes.narration: GoMining's docs say the fee covers electricity and equipment service.
It is deducted from the pool reward. Net reward is reward minus those fees, after any discounts.
Paying in GOMINING tokens can give a discount of up to twenty percent. Terms can change.

cta: Do you check yours daily? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
description_body: Net reward is pool reward minus electricity and service, after discounts.

sources.title: GoMining docs: maintenance fees and discounts
